targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-24 (V3-EXQ-793, diagnostic, claim_ids=[SD-049]; failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-793_2026-07-24). All 3 manifest preconditions and all 4 criteria (C_BASE_FAILS, C_CURR, C_DENS, load-bearing C_JOINT) pass at the arm level: A00 (base curriculum, density off) reproduces the 693a ceiling (0.0202, just under the 0.02 threshold, d3_clears=false); A10 (amended curriculum alone) and A01 (density-preserving spawn alone) each independently clear the D3 gate; A11 (both) also clears. Self-routed label both_levers_sufficient_alone. HOWEVER per-seed guard_pass shows real fragility not visible in the arm-level criteria: A11 (both levers) fails guard_pass on 2/3 seeds despite the arm-level contact_rate pass; A01 and A10 each show 1/3 seed guard failures. The arm-level PASS rests on a majority-by-contact_rate reading that does not require guard_pass, so this is a genuine but THIN result -- read as informative for curriculum/environment design (both levers independently help), not as a decisive, robust confirmation. Separately: SD-049 is parked (epistemic_category substrate_ceiling, ceiling_decision deferred, 2026-06-19 triage) on a DIFFERENT and unaddressed prerequisite -- Phase-2 V3-EXQ-514 full validation is blocked on a foraging-COMPETENT policy (~0.2% consumption on the enriched reef), which this D3-gate lever-sufficiency diagnostic does not test or lift. SD-049 stays candidate/v3_pending/substrate_ceiling/deferred; this run does not change that park.

re_derive_brake.note: SD-049's one prior substrate_ceiling hit (538a) is on the DIFFERENT foraging-competence prerequisite, not the curriculum/density lever question 793 tests. If a repowered follow-up on A11 specifically (more seeds, explicit guard-pass as a load-bearing criterion) is queued, that is a legitimate targeted power fix, not a same-question re-letter of a ceilinged claim.

learning_extracted: Both the curriculum amendment and the density-preserving spawn independently lift the D3 gate over the 693a baseline -- a genuine, narrow curriculum/environment-design finding.

The arm-level d3_clears criterion (majority-by-contact_rate) can pass while the per-seed guard fails on a majority of seeds -- this is a real gap in the diagnostic's own criteria design: guard_pass should arguably be load-bearing for a joint-levers arm, not just contact_rate.

This result does not lift SD-049's parked substrate_ceiling status -- the park is gated on a foraging-competent policy for Phase-2 validation (V3-EXQ-514), which this diagnostic neither tests nor addresses.
